notes.title: Feb 16 save hotfix
notes.content: Fix new saves not working correctly after latest patch

notes.title: Bigger custom characters now available
notes.content:
Added ability to make bigger custom characters using "scalePercent" value in config.txt. Mods can now be up to 200% more massive. If you made a workshop character that looks too small you can now update it by adding that simple value and reuploading it (check info in the workshop guide, and the new Dummy config.txt). Mods without the value are still compatible.

Thanks to bombablake for the suggestion. More news coming soon.

notes.title: Language bugfix
notes.content: - Fixed a crash on startup when playing in Chinese, Russian and Spanish

notes.title: Contest for the last secret achievement!
notes.content:
Nobody has discovered how to get the "Love is all you need" achievement. [b]Time for a contest![/b]

[h3]The [b]first person[/b] to unlock and explain how to get this achievement will get a [b]special prize[/b], plus the permanent, [b]unique title[/b] of [b]"King of Hearts"[/b] or [b]"Queen of Hearts"[/b].[/h3]

During the contest, the community can ask me [b]one question per day[/b]. I set up a special [b][url=discord.flypunchboom.com]#hunt-for-secret channel on the Discord server[/url][/b] so you can exchange theories, test things together and discuss what you want to ask every day.

Right after the game released, some crazy players scoured the game and unlocked every secret there was to discover, apart from this one. I never thought you would find the "Faces of Darkness" so quickly... (looking at you Meris and Meistersteve) And now, it's time to finally 100% this game!

[b]LET THE HUNT BEGIN[/b], and as always, may the power of anime be with you.

[h3]And if you don't have the [b]full game[/b] yet, it's [b]now ON SALE![/b] Don't miss it![/h3]
